gates.unit: node --test tests/battle-coleto*.test.mjs, the named test and no other

unit.name: the column never leaves Goliad: the men wait at the presidio and cannot reach the square in time
unit.expect: Fannin's men march out of Goliad with the column at nine, walk with it to Coleto and stand in the square when it forms; nobody new joins him
failed: Fannin's men march out of Goliad with the column at nine, walk with it to Coleto and stand in the square when it forms; nobody new joins him

unit.name: recall read off the class's own minute: shut eighteen hours before anybody marched
unit.expect: recall shuts when the column marches, on the director's clock - not eighteen hours before
failed: recall shuts when the column marches, on the director's clock - not eighteen hours before

unit.name: a death on the family's screen the moment he falls, before the word
unit.expect: each man's fate falls at its moment inside the fighting, from the roll the game always made; a wound shows at once, a death waits for the word, and the dead man lies where he fell
failed: each man's fate falls at its moment inside the fighting, from the roll the game always made; a wound shows at once, a death waits for the word, and the dead man lies where he fell

unit.name: the dead man is marched back to Goliad with the prisoners
unit.expect: each man's fate falls at its moment inside the fighting, from the roll the game always made; a wound shows at once, a death waits for the word, and the dead man lies where he fell
failed: each man's fate falls at its moment inside the fighting, from the roll the game always made; a wound shows at once, a death waits for the word, and the dead man lies where he fell

unit.name: nobody rides with Horton
unit.expect: a man with his own horse may ride with Horton's scouts, is cut off in the timber when the column is caught, and rides home; nobody without one does
failed: a man with his own horse may ride with Horton's scouts, is cut off in the timber when the column is caught, and rides home; nobody without one does

unit.name: a man still wounded runs for the river (G2 undone)
unit.expect: Palm Sunday: each prisoner meets the record's share at its own moment; a man still wounded cannot run; the man who gets away starts home at once and tells it himself
failed: Palm Sunday: each prisoner meets the record's share at its own moment; a man still wounded cannot run; the man who gets away starts home at once and tells it himself

unit.name: the man who got away waits at the river for the word before he starts home
unit.expect: Palm Sunday: each prisoner meets the record's share at its own moment; a man still wounded cannot run; the man who gets away starts home at once and tells it himself
failed: Palm Sunday: each prisoner meets the record's share at its own moment; a man still wounded cannot run; the man who gets away starts home at once and tells it himself

unit.name: the account at the word tells Coleto and leaves Palm Sunday out
unit.expect: afterwards every other family with a man there is told through whoever hears it at home - Coleto and Goliad together, the escapes, those spared, and "Remember Goliad"
failed: afterwards every other family with a man there is told through whoever hears it at home - Coleto and Goliad together, the escapes, those spared, and "Remember Goliad"

unit.name: every family is sent the fight, wherever its people are
unit.expect: who is sent what: the Host always, framed on the field while it is fought; a family only while its man is there; nobody else, not a fate before it falls
failed: who is sent what: the Host always, framed on the field while it is fought; a family only while its man is there; nobody else, not a fate before it falls

unit.name: the march and the muster offered as Watch
unit.expect: the alerts come through the man: Follow on the march, Watch when the column is caught and when the guns open, Follow at the muster; never to a family with nobody there
failed: the alerts come through the man: Follow on the march, Watch when the column is caught and when the guns open, Follow at the muster; never to a family with nobody there

unit.name: a class saved before the engine is never given Coleto
unit.expect: a class saved in the middle of Coleto reopens in the middle of it, and one saved before the engine gains it from the clock, with no save version moved
failed: a class saved in the middle of Coleto reopens in the middle of it, and one saved before the engine gains it from the clock, with no save version moved

unit.name: the night at Coleto watched twenty minutes a tick: the fight runs past the lesson
unit.expect: the clock is held for Coleto: the fighting about ten real minutes at the Study pace, the whole of it under fifteen, never faster than it was going
failed: the clock is held for Coleto: the fighting about ten real minutes at the Study pace, the whole of it under fifteen, never faster than it was going

unit.name: the square's men face in
unit.expect: the square is four faces of three ranks, each man facing out of his own face, drawn evenly; the marksmen in the grass are loose
failed: the square is four faces of three ranks, each man facing out of his own face, drawn evenly; the marksmen in the grass are loose

unit.name: a fallen man moves with his company

failed: a man who falls lies where he fell while his company falls back; a family's man hit is drawn down, never before; in the square he faces out of his own face

unit.name: the night is drawn as day
